verdict.rationale: Tilled documents merchant pricing managed through partner-created pricing templates per payment method, which covers per-seller pricing and implies the platform can set merchant rates. Nothing documents an explicit application fee or markup mechanism on each transaction, or reporting that separates platform revenue from processing costs. missing for 10: explicit per-transaction application fee/markup documentation, payments-revenue vs processing-cost reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, payments are a revenue line — take an application fee or markup on every transaction, set per-seller pricing, and see my payments revenue reported distinctly from processing costs

citations.quote: Merchant pricing is managed using pricing templates, which serve as a repository of pricing information for a specific payment method.
To create a new pricing template: Navigate to **Pricing Templates**
